title: Materialize CAP-124 Audacity MCP provider boundary without adding capability or authority
rules: CAP-124 remains the sole capability projection; no duplicate audio-edit capability is created.
Central MCP Gateway remains the only canonical MCP/tool execution boundary.
The xDarkzx upstream installer is not executed by FA3 because it can modify Audacity and Claude Desktop configuration.
Audacity 4 is fail-closed for the xDarkzx provider until a stable admitted automation interface exists; no implicit GUI automation fallback.
OpenVINO stays an optional inference provider behind existing Model Router/HRB admission.
Ardour remains the primary human audio finishing DAW provider; Audacity is repair/utility editing.
Provider absence or incompatibility cannot fail unrelated FA3 audio capabilities.
